# Abishek Hospital, Erode, Tamil Nadu

> Abishek Hospital is a women's health and maternity hospital at Erode Fort, Tamil Nadu, India, led by Dr. Jayanthi Prabakaran, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist. It provides pregnancy and delivery care (normal, painless/epidural and caesarean), high-risk pregnancy care, gynaecology, PCOS treatment, fertility and IUI treatment, laparoscopic (keyhole) surgery and online consultation. Emergency care is available 24 hours.

## Key facts
- Name: Abishek Hospital (also written Abishek Medical Center), Erode, Tamil Nadu, India
- What it is: a women's health and maternity hospital (obstetrics and gynaecology). One hospital, at Erode Fort. There are no branches in other cities.
- Address: No.18, Near Bus Stand, Bharathi Street, Erode Fort, Erode - 638001, Tamil Nadu, India
- Doctor: Dr. Jayanthi Prabakaran, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Academic Topper from Coimbatore Medical College. Tamil Nadu Medical Council registration number 60813 (as supplied by the doctor). Over 40,000 safe deliveries.
- Outpatient clinic hours: Mon – Sat, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM. Emergency care: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 97505 11225. Email: info@abishekhospital.com
- Languages: Tamil and English. Tamil pages: https://abishekhospital.com/ta/
- Online consultation (audio or video call with the gynaecologist): Rs 499 for up to 15 minutes; the time slot is confirmed on WhatsApp based on the doctor's availability. https://abishekhospital.com/online-consultation/
- Reviews: 5.0 rating from 1,700+ Google reviews (as shown on the hospital's Google Business Profile, November 2026). See them at https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Abishek+Hospital+Erode+Fort+Tamil+Nadu
- Numbers published by the hospital: 40,000+ Safe deliveries; 2,500+ Epidural (painless) deliveries; 500+ IUI conceptions; 7,000+ Laparoscopic gynaecological surgeries.
- Official channels: website https://abishekhospital.com; YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@drjayanthiprabakaran (@drjayanthiprabakaran); Instagram https://www.instagram.com/abishekmedicalcenter; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/dr.jayanthi.prabakaran
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Abishek+Hospital+Erode+Fort+Tamil+Nadu

## Services
- [Online Consultation](https://abishekhospital.com/online-consultation/): Talk to the gynaecologist from home by audio or video call. ₹499 for up to 15 minutes, with a slot based on the doctor’s availability.
- [Maternity & Pregnancy Care](https://abishekhospital.com/maternity-hospital-erode/): Antenatal checkups, delivery and postnatal care, with emergency care available 24/7.
- [Normal & Painless Delivery](https://abishekhospital.com/normal-painless-delivery-erode/): Supported normal delivery with the option of epidural (painless) labour. Over 2,500 epidural deliveries.
- [Caesarean (C-Section) Delivery](https://abishekhospital.com/caesarean-delivery-erode/): When a caesarean is advised, what to expect during the operation and how to recover.
- [High-Risk Pregnancy Care](https://abishekhospital.com/high-risk-pregnancy-erode/): Specialised, closely monitored care for complex pregnancies, with 24/7 monitoring.
- [Postnatal Care](https://abishekhospital.com/postnatal-care-erode/): Recovery after normal or caesarean delivery, breastfeeding support, your mood and your postnatal checkup.
- [Gynaecology & Women’s Health](https://abishekhospital.com/gynecologist-erode/): Lady doctor consultations for periods, fibroids, cysts, discharge, pelvic pain, menopause and family planning.
- [Fibroids & Ovarian Cysts](https://abishekhospital.com/fibroids-ovarian-cyst-treatment-erode/): Heavy periods, pelvic pain or pressure: tests and treatment options, including keyhole surgery when needed.
- [PCOS / PCOD Treatment](https://abishekhospital.com/pcos-treatment-erode/): Diagnosis and management of PCOS, thyroid and other hormonal conditions.
- [Fertility & IUI Treatment](https://abishekhospital.com/infertility-treatment-erode/): Fertility evaluation and IUI treatment, with over 500 conceptions through IUI.
- [Laparoscopic (Keyhole) Surgery](https://abishekhospital.com/laparoscopic-surgery-erode/): Minimally invasive gynaecological surgery. Over 7,000 laparoscopic surgeries performed.

## Women's health guides
- [Irregular Periods: Causes and Treatment | Abishek Hospital](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/irregular-periods/): Why periods become irregular (PCOS, thyroid, stress, weight) and when to see a gynecologist in Erode. A guide from Abishek Hospital. Call 97505 11225.
- [White Discharge: Normal or Not? | Abishek Hospital, Erode](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/white-discharge/): When white discharge is normal, when it is a sign of infection, and when to see a gynecologist. Simple guide from Abishek Hospital. Call 97505 11225.
- [Early Pregnancy Symptoms & First Steps | Abishek Hospital](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/early-pregnancy-symptoms/): Early signs of pregnancy, when to take a test, what to do in the first weeks and the danger signs. A simple guide from Abishek Hospital. Call 97505 11225.
- [Normal Delivery or Caesarean? | Abishek Hospital](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/normal-delivery-vs-caesarean/): Normal (vaginal) delivery and caesarean compared: benefits, risks, recovery and when a caesarean is advised. A plain guide from Abishek Hospital, Erode.
- [Food & Care in Early Pregnancy | Abishek Hospital](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/food-and-care-in-early-pregnancy/): What to eat, what to avoid and how to ease nausea in early pregnancy, with everyday Tamil Nadu foods. A guide from Abishek Hospital, Erode. Call 97505 11225.
- [Care After Delivery and Warning Signs | Abishek Hospital](https://abishekhospital.com/women-health-guides/care-after-delivery/): Looking after yourself after a normal delivery or caesarean: bleeding, stitches, feeding, mood and warning signs. A guide from Abishek Hospital, Erode.

## Towns we serve
- [Salem](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/salem/): about 58 km from Erode Fort, about 1 to 1½ hours by road
- [Tiruppur](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/tiruppur/): about 48 km from Erode Fort, about 1 to 1½ hours by road
- [Namakkal](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/namakkal/): about 57 km from Erode Fort, about 1 to 1½ hours by road
- [Karur](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/karur/): about 65 km from Erode Fort, about 1½ hours by road
- [Coimbatore](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/coimbatore/): about 90 km from Erode Fort, about 2 hours by road
- [Gobichettipalayam](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/gobichettipalayam/): about 37 km from Erode Fort, about 1 hour by road
